patch_list: NoBrokerHood: Default browser, block known ad hosts (experimental)
Keep default-browser support but block known Multipl and Innovid ad-tracking hosts.
Empty app-bar banner entries; may leave a layout placeholder.
Skip the AppBarIsland.kt horizontal row. May hide non-ad items.
Remove app-bar advertising card data before creating banner state.
Hide the fallback ad card after entry approval. Null handling is untested.
Hide large banner images in entry/exit notifications while retaining text (3.6.11).
Hide the SideAd.kt Compose renderer attached to the RIGHT_AD home section.
Hide cards in the homepage discover carousel; may hide non-ad items too.
Hide the homepage top billboard by clearing TopAdState during construction.
Supply an empty top-ad list and disable its loading/expanded state.
Hide homepage items marked ISLAND_BANNER; test against the blue Domino's strip.
Hide the sponsored card shown after entry approval or pre-approval (3.6.11).
Suppress image, GIF, video and Lottie ad cards after approval, without blocking the approval status.
Suppress the draggable multimedia promotion card; verify on-device.
Do not initialize the image/video ad RecyclerView after entry approval; preserve approval details.
Stop the home-screen full-screen alert reminder without changing permissions.
NoBrokerHood: Stop promotional browser launches from notifications
Clear advertising click metadata and browser-directed routes from notification intents, preserving security-event fields (experimental).
